1.text: By the sky and the knocker

2.text: And what can make you know what is the knocker?

3.text: It is the piercing star<sup foot_note="228217">1</sup>.

footnotes.228217: - Whose light pierces through the darkness.

4.text: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

5.text: So let man observe from what he was created.

6.text: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

7.text: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

8.text: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

9.text: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,<sup foot_note="228218">1</sup>

10.text: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

11.text: By the sky which sends back<sup foot_note="228219">1</sup>

12.text: And [by] the earth which splits,<sup foot_note="228220">1</sup>

footnotes.228220: - With plant growth or from geological rifts.

13.text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

15.text: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

16.text: But I am planning a plan.

17.text: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.<sup foot_note="228221">1</sup>

footnotes.228221: - i.e., Do not be in haste for revenge, for you will see what will become of them.
